name: Adaptive Risk & Pattern Focus

restricted_triggers.4h_engulfing: Requires confirmed 15M CHoCH displacement and subsequent retest before execution.

axioms: Never trade assets where minimum lot size risk exceeds 1% of account balance, regardless of pattern confidence.
Discontinue trading patterns with zero win rate until a robust, data-backed confirming signal is integrated into the entry logic.
Ensure stop-loss placement accounts for market noise, using a minimum of 1.5x average true range or specified pip/percentage minimums to prevent premature exits.
Prioritize execution on asset classes and patterns demonstrating positive expectancy and a proven win rate above 20%.
evolution_summary: This generation significantly tightens risk management by restricting high-loss patterns and assets, while widening stop-losses to reduce noise-induced exits. It prioritizes the only profitable asset class and trigger pattern, aiming for higher quality trades and improved expectancy.
